== Notes ==

* Fendi Nin takes double damage from [[holy damage]]. 

* In order to defeat Fendi Nin (and gain credit for the dungeon and associated quest), you must kill his soul. The basic mechanics work like this:
** Whenever Fendi Nin dies, two things happen: he is replaced by the [[Soul of Fendi Nin]] and all the [[Skeleton Archer]]s with him disappear.
** The soul remains for 30 seconds and the archers are replaced by an equal number of [[Damned Crewman|Damned Crewmen]].
** Whenever the soul disappears, Fendi Nin reappears the same location, at full health; the archers also [[spawn|respawn]]. 
** You must repeatedly kill Fendi Nin to make his soul reappear and (eventually) whittle its health down; the soul does not regenerate health.

* These mechanics are often exploited in one of two ways:
*# The crewmen spawn exactly where the archers appeared in the previous cycle; if you [[pull]] Fendi Nin far enough away from the original location before killing him, you will be out of range of the respawning crewmen. (The reverse is not true: the archers always spawn with Fendi Nin.)
*# Fendi Nin and his soul always spawn at the spot that the other disappeared. If you pull either to the fire jets, both incarnations and their allies will appear/re-appear in the flames.

* If Fendi Nin is pulled far away from his starting location, his soul will attempt to return to his original location. You can [[body block]] it from moving (which also will separate the soul from the crewmen). This allows you to pull both incarnations an arbitrary distance from the final room.
